clips.title: The story
paras: In Bloodhoof Village, Yaw Sharpmane guides young tauren hunters. He teaches them to track, survive, and tame Mulgore's wild beasts.

Yaw Sharpmane teaches marksmanship, tracking, and survival in Bloodhoof Village. Young hunters who have proven themselves in Red Cloud Mesa come to him to hone their skills before venturing onto the wider plains of Mulgore.

Yaw Sharpmane guides new hunters through the ancient rite of taming wild beasts. He asks them to bond with Mulgore's native animals, testing their patience and respect for nature's balance. Then he teaches them to care for and train a lasting companion.
